properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: hash.js 1.1.7 is the SHA-1/SHA-2 hash toolkit pulled into the installed tree by elliptic/ethers-style blockchain packages. No direct first-party call site found; presence in the shipped tree is what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: node-forge@1.3.1 is the transitive provider of RSA (keygen/encrypt) and X.509 tooling, pulled in by the selfsigned package used to generate self-signed certificates for the e2e/dev HTTPS servers. Changeable here via resolutions; RSA key transport is harvestable (retroactive risk) → ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live first-party call through the project's crypto layer: Secp256k1.randomBytes(16) from @vechain/sdk-core mints the 16-byte random challenge for the Sync2 wallet-certificate session (createSync2 passes it as randomBytes to @vechain/connex-wallet-buddy create()). The secp256k1 module is invoked here as a CSPRNG, not for ECDSA signing — the quantum-unsafe secp256k1 curve still ships in the SDK this library drives.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: @noble/curves@1.2.0 ships the secp256k1 ECDSA implementation that underpins VeChain wallet/account code (@vechain/sdk-core uses it). First-party app code reaches the curve through the @vechain/sdk-core wrapper (see create-sync2.ts). Quantum-unsafe signature curve; deadline risk → ML-DSA-65. Changeable here via resolutions.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: @noble/curves@1.2.0 ships Ed25519 (and secp256k1, X25519) implementations; pulled transitively (e.g. via @vechain/sdk-core / ethers-style wallet code). The build ships these classical signature algorithms whether or not the app calls each one. Quantum-unsafe (Shor). Migration on a schedule: ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: elliptic@6.6.1 provides classical ECDSA (secp256k1) — transitive dependency, no direct first-party import found in source. Shipped in the build's dependency tree; quantum-unsafe signature → ML-DSA-65 on a schedule.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: @noble/curves 1.2.0 is pinned by @vechain/sdk-core@2.1.0 (yarn.lock:7532) and ships P-256 ECDSA/ECDH among its curves. No direct first-party import; the capability ships in the installed tree via the SDK.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: elliptic 6.6.1 (ECDH/ECDSA over secp256k1/P-256) resolved in the lockfile, transitively reached by blockchain tooling. No first-party ECDH call site found; the library ships in the installed tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: tweetnacl@0.14.5 ships X25519 (crypto_box key agreement); transitive dependency, no first-party import site found in source. If exercised, X25519 is harvest-now-decrypt-later key agreement → ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: node-forge 1.3.1 (AES among many primitives) is in the tree via selfsigned@2.4.1, which generates the dev/preview server's self-signed HTTPS certificate. Dev/test infrastructure, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: @noble/hashes 1.3.2 pinned by @vechain/sdk-core@2.1.0 (yarn.lock:7532); supplies SHA-256/SHA-3/BLAKE2/keccak to the SDK's hashing APIs this library drives.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.3.2 ships BLAKE3; transitive (via the @vechain/noble dependency stack). Hash primitive — only Grover-relevant, not urgent for PQ migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.3.2 ships SHA-3; transitive (via the @vechain/noble stack). Hash primitive — Grover only halves security; not urgent.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: @noble/ciphers 1.2.1 pinned by @vechain/sdk-core@2.1.0 (yarn.lock:7532); ships AES-GCM used by the SDK's encryption layer. No direct first-party AES-GCM call site found; the cipher ships in the installed tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: @noble/ciphers 1.2.1 pinned by @vechain/sdk-core@2.1.0; ships ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD among its ciphers. No direct first-party call site found; the cipher ships in the installed tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: tweetnacl@0.14.5's crypto_secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305 AE) ships with the transitive dependency; no first-party call site found. Symmetric AE with 256-bit keys — quantum-resistant in practice (Grover halves 256→128-bit).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: selfsigned 2.4.1 generates the self-signed X.509 dev certificate for the local HTTPS preview server (webpack-dev-server style), using node-forge for the PKI work. Dev/test infrastructure, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: node-forge 1.3.1 provides the X.509/PKI machinery behind selfsigned@2.4.1's dev-server certificate. Dev/test infrastructure, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: ssh2@1.16.0 is transitive, pulled by docker-modem@5.0.6 / dockerode@4.0.4 (the Docker API client used by the e2e/test tooling); docker-modem uses ssh2 only to reach Docker daemons over SSH. Dev/test tooling, not shipped runtime code — but it is a classical SSH stack in the tree (ecdh-sha2/dh KEX → ML-KEM hybrids once available). Changeable here via resolutions.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: tweetnacl 0.14.5 (NaCl secretbox/box/sign) enters the tree only as a dependency of bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2, itself required by ssh2@1.16.0 for the docker/ssh test tooling. Ships in the installed dev tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: ssh2 1.16.0 (SSH-2 transport: curve25519-sha256 KEX, ssh-ed25519 host keys) is required by docker-modem@5.0.6 and ssh-remote-port-forward@1.0.4 — container and remote-port-forward tooling for the e2e test rig, not code shipped in the dapp-kit library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: sha.js 2.4.12, the browserify SHA-1/SHA-256 polyfill, is force-pinned by the root package.json resolutions block (package.json:64); it ships in the build tree for browser crypto polyfills.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared crypto dependency: classic elliptic-curve library (secp256k1 ECDSA/ECDH), pulled transitively (elliptic@6.6.1 lineage of ethers/hdkey-style wallet code). Presence is the inventory question: the build ships these classical EC algorithms; no direct first-party call site found in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared crypto dependency: @noble/hashes@1.3.2 (SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE2/3, RIPEMD, etc.), pulled transitively via the @vechain/noble stack. Ships with the build; presence recorded regardless of per-algorithm call sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared crypto dependency: selfsigned@2.4.1 generates self-signed X.509 certificates (RSA keys via node-forge) — dev/e2e tooling for local HTTPS servers. The RSA keys it mints are quantum-unsafe but throwaway test artifacts; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared crypto dependency: pure-JS hash implementations (SHA-2/RIPEMD lineage), transitive via elliptic@6.6.1. Pinned indirectly through the locked tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: @noble/curves 1.2.0 pinned by @vechain/sdk-core@2.1.0 (yarn.lock:7532); supplies the secp256k1/P-256/ed25519 primitives the SDK exposes to this library. No direct first-party import; reached through the SDK wrapper.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared crypto dependency: pbkdf2@3.1.3, the browser polyfill for Node's crypto.pbkdf2, pinned at root level by the yarn resolutions field. Same dependency as ALG-4de3b020's locked entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency entry: @noble/ciphers 1.2.1 pinned by @vechain/sdk-core@2.1.0 (yarn.lock:7532); supplies AES/Salsa/ChaCha ciphers behind the SDK's encryption APIs. No direct first-party import; reached through the SDK wrapper.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared crypto dependency: node-forge@1.3.1 implements RSA, X.509 and TLS in pure JS; pulled by selfsigned for dev/test certificate generation. Ships RSA (quantum-unsafe key transport) in the dependency tree; same locked package the ALG-589856a1 RSA object was derived from.
